ModMetaData.name: Load Support
ModMetaData.author: aRed
ModMetaData.description:
Carrying capacity that follows the body.
Each pawn gets a LoadSupport multiplier (healthy = x1.00), worked out from the current state of its legs, core (spine, pelvis, torso) and arms. Missing limbs lower it; prosthetics, bionics, archotech parts and modded replacement parts raise it.
- Works with modded bionics and races without compatibility patches. It reads RimWorld's own part-efficiency system, not DefNames. - Superhuman parts scale nonlinearly (efficiency^2.5 by default). - There is a structural bottleneck: super-legs on a normal spine help, but the spine limits them. - Multiplies the existing carrying capacity (genes, traits, body size and other mods are kept). Optionally also applies to inventory and caravan mass. - Nothing is written to your save. Safe to add or remove mid-game.
Requires Harmony. v0.1: the core system only.
